site: Cargill local application recovery; all reading-agent Review handoffs
class: Different handoff branches did not share automation resume lifecycle
symptom: After reloading the posting-navigation fix, the run immediately paused again with automation is parked for human handoff.
root_cause: human_handoff parked automation at Review, but run_page_agent re-armed containment only after ordinary handoffs. Continue, refresh, and reload at Review re-entered PageAgent with execution still parked.
why_tests_missed: Existing tests checked resume_automation directly and module reload order, but never drove both real run_page_agent handoff branches through a resumed second agent.run call.
fix: Both handoff branches call one resume_handoff_action helper that re-arms containment only for nonterminal actions, preserving authentication hold policy.
prevention: Exercise the complete handoff/resume lifecycle for every stop branch, including reload, refresh, Continue, and terminal decisions; verify the next agent execution is active with containment re-armed.
